title: N1 Numeric Separators
intro:
Printed marks include raised dots (·), full stops (.), commas (,), hyphens (-), en dashes (–), em dashes (—), spaces and empty gaps.
“Ours” is our reading of every gap, prefilled in the editable field for you to correct.
Dashes are only tagged in the training labels for now.
boxes with a dashed outline are gaps we have not decided yet; their Google character is kept in Ours
